morning.title: Purani kharab photo ko AI se naya banao - bilkul FREE
morning.benefit: Viewer ghar ki purani, phati ya blur family photo ko free AI tool se 1 minute mein saaf aur rangeen bana payega - studio ke paise bachenge
morning.angle: Free photo restore tools (RestoreOldPhotos.io ya Google/Gemini image edit) - pehle vs baad dikhao; free limit official page se verify karo; 1-2 min, steps itne saaf ki viewer reel rok ke kar sake

noon.title: ChatGPT/Claude se 10 minute mein naukri wala resume - exact prompt
noon.benefit: Viewer apna resume free AI se 10 minute mein bana ke usi din job apply kar payega - resume banwane ke paise bachenge
noon.angle: Free plan pe chalne wala exact prompt screen pe dikhao (copy karne layak), apni details kaise bharein, galti kya na karein (jhooth mat likho); 1-2 min

evening.title: College students: Google AI Plus 1 saal FREE - 31 Dec se pehle claim karo
evening.benefit: College student viewer Google AI Plus (Gemini Omni, 2x limits, 400 GB storage) 1 saal free claim kar payega, deadline se pehle
evening.angle: Eligibility (18+, university student, verify), claim steps gemini.google/in/students se, deadline 31 Dec 2026 - sab official page se dobara verify karo; jo students nahi hain unke liye 1 line free Gemini option; 1-2 min
